mapper.insert: INSERT INTO verification_credential_command(id,command_namespace,actor_type,actor_id,authority_scope,request_id,canonical_version,payload_sha256,canonical_bytes,state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{namespace},#{actorType},#{actor},#{scope},#{requestId},'canonical-v1',#{hash},#{canonical},'RESERVED',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT id,canonical_version,payload_sha256,canonical_bytes,state,result_version,result_bytes FROM verification_credential_command WHERE command_namespace=#{namespace} AND actor_type=#{actorType} AND actor_id=#{actor} AND authority_scope=#{scope} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE verification_credential_command SET state='SUCCEEDED',result_version=1,result_bytes=#{result},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND state='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT order_id,store_id,reservation_id,epoch,current_credential_id,version,locked_until FROM verification_credential_state WHERE order_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM verification_credential WHERE order_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM verification_reschedule_fence WHERE order_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM verification_credential_risk_attempt WHERE order_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM verification_credential_refresh WHERE order_id=#{id})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM verification_credential WHERE order_id=#{id} AND invalidated_at IS NULL
SELECT credential_id FROM verification_credential_refresh WHERE command_id=#{id}
SELECT id,order_id,result_code,attempted_at FROM verification_credential_risk_attempt WHERE command_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE verification_credential SET invalidated_at=#{now},invalidated_reason=#{reason} WHERE order_id=#{order} AND invalidated_at IS NULL
UPDATE verification_credential_state SET epoch=#{epoch},current_credential_id=#{credential,jdbcType=BIGINT},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE order_id=#{order} AND version=#{oldVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM verification_credential_refresh WHERE order_id=#{order} AND user_id=#{user} AND refresh_kind='MANUAL' AND committed_at > #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM verification_credential_risk_attempt WHERE order_id=#{order} AND counts_failure=1 AND attempted_at > #{since}
mapper.update: UPDATE verification_credential_state SET locked_until=#{until},updated_at=#{now} WHERE order_id=#{order}
